column1: # Every place an output format's name is written today, obtained by asking where
# existing ones are written. The new `suppressed` format has to appear in each of
# these or it exists without being findable; DI registration is the one channel
# Regenerate with (two probes, union — one name is not enough, see below):
# ROW COUNT: 63 files — 10 product, 18 test, 15 website, 7 gate, 4 component
# READMEs, the repository front page, `action.yml`, 6 historical (ADRs and plan
# documents) and 1 generated inventory. The last two groups are not edited by a
# HOW THIS WAS PRODUCED, AND WHAT THE FIRST ATTEMPT MISSED
# The first probe searched `checkstyle` under src/ tests/ scripts/ website/ docs/
# finding-gate/ only, and missed three real channels because the repository ROOT
# was not in the path list and because not every list names checkstyle:
# (which also branches on the format when naming the output file), and
# `website/docs/llms.txt`. Both fixes are in the command above: search from the
# root, and use two format names rather than one.
# WHAT THIS METHOD STILL DOES NOT SEE
# - A list that names no format this probe knows. Checked by hand for the two
#   lists that generate the others: `Surfaces::FORMATS` (the gate) and
# - The registration channel, deliberately silent: a `*Formatter` implementing
#   FormatterInterface is autoconfigured and needs no list entry (AGENTS.md §7).
# - Reachability from `qmx.yaml` rather than from --format. Answered separately
#   and it matters: `ConfigSchema::FORMAT` makes `format: suppressed` a legal
#   configuration key, which is why the capture gate may not hang off the CLI
